# Fixture

A [`Thing`](/documentation/Fixture/Thing) whose [`run(_:)`](/documentation/Fixture/Thing/run(_:)-8uxly) compares with [`!=(_:_:)`](/documentation/Fixture/Thing/!=(_:_:)), see the [Guide](/documentation/Fixture/Guide#Section).
It is a [`BaseModule`](/documentation/ExpoModulesCore/BaseModule).
